before.lib/account.ex:
defmodule Account do
  use Ecto.Schema
  schema "accounts" do
    field :email, :string
  end
end

after.lib/account.ex:
defmodule Account do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset
  schema "accounts" do
    field :email, :string
  end
  def changeset(account, attrs) do
    account
    |> cast(attrs, [:email])
    |> validate_required([:email])
    |> unsafe_validate_unique(:email, App.Repo)
    |> unique_constraint(:email)
  end
end
